primary_metric: Family-macro direct-effect balanced accuracy, averaged over all four rounds, at budget 8 in the OR-readout condition.
core: Compose unchanged CausalCore, LearnedReadoutObservationAdapter and IdentityMemory. Fit the original core on the most recent supplied batch for each observed action-context key; write observed effect values into the existing tuple memory. Unvisited keys retain their entries. This is a component-composition experiment, not execution of the historical autonomous planner.
context_scope: Two context bits are observed and supplied to every learner. Context keys are complete observed assignments. This tests conditional separation and retention, not hidden-context discovery.
readout_scope: Opaque variable names; no true physical/readout roles or target identities are supplied. Original formula learner: min_observations 40, min_accuracy .98, max_candidate_sources 8. Refresh at the end of each batch round. Shared-filter controls receive exactly its learned suppression set.
memory_scope: Source covers all 12 action-context cells. Round 1 reverses one active cell's set value; round 2 reverses another action's active cell; round 3 restores the first cell's source value. All algorithms receive the same announced round boundaries and full history. No target renaming or alignment discovery is tested.
selection: Select each tree baseline's hyperparameters using only development primary BA; break ties in grid order. Freeze protocol, module hashes, driver and selected settings before confirmation. Forest setting is fixed.
fairness: Same raw interventions, before/after observations, round labels, visible context and full history. Baselines fit observed changed-variable labels, not ground-truth direct labels. Shared-filter baselines apply the same learned filter, never a true-role oracle. No method receives the simulator's mechanism map.
controls: No-readout, noisy-OR and identity-copy conditions are mandatory scope controls. Identity copies can be nonidentifiable from these records. All outcomes and baseline variants are retained. Clean test pairs measure physical responses; independent raw labels for probes are evaluation-only.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over 16 independent held-out procedural families; neither cells, queries nor rounds are counted as independent trained agents.
manuscript: Leave revision files and earlier experiments unchanged. Do not interpret this finite observed-context study as new MuJoCo or LLM evidence.
